titleEn: Tub to Shower Conversion in Vancouver: Real Costs, Process & Permits (2026)
titleZh: 溫哥華浴缸改淋浴：真實費用、流程與許可（2026年）
contentEn:
Converting a bathtub to a walk-in shower in Vancouver costs between $8,500 and $18,000 in 2026, depending on bathroom size, plumbing complexity, and material choices. 聚星装修 has completed tub-to-shower conversions across Metro Vancouver, with recent projects in Coquitlam, North Vancouver, Richmond and Delta.

How Much Does a Tub to Shower Conversion Cost in Vancouver?

A standard tub-to-shower conversion in Metro Vancouver starts at approximately $8,500 for a basic conversion with standard fixtures. The majority of conversions fall in the $10,000–$14,000 range when plumbing modifications and quality finishes are included. Luxury curbless conversions with glass enclosures and high-end tile can reach $16,000–$18,000.

Conversion TypeApproximate Cost Range (CAD)
Basic tub replacement with standard shower insert$8,500 – $11,000
Full demolition with plumbing reconfiguration$11,000 – $14,500
Curbless walk-in with custom tile and glass$14,500 – $18,000

These ranges are based on actual 聚星装修 project invoices from 2025 and 2026 across Metro Vancouver municipalities.

The Tub to Shower Conversion Process in Vancouver

Every tub-to-shower conversion in Vancouver follows a structured process that accounts for Metro Vancouver's building codes and permit requirements. 聚星装修 manages the entire process from initial assessment through final inspection.

Step 1: Initial Assessment and Measurement

A 聚星装修 estimator visits the site to assess the existing tub, measure the rough-in plumbing, and evaluate whether the drain location is compatible with a shower configuration. In older Vancouver homes built before 1990, the original cast-iron drain may need relocation, which affects cost.

Step 2: Permit Application (if required)

In Vancouver, Coquitlam, North Vancouver, Richmond and Delta, a plumbing permit is required if the conversion involves moving drain lines or altering the wet area. 聚星装修 handles permit applications as part of project management. Metro Vancouver permit fees typically range from $150 to $350.

Step 3: Demolition and Rough-In

The existing tub and surround are removed. If drain or supply line reconfiguration is needed, this work is completed during the rough-in phase. Waterproofing is then applied to the subfloor and walls before any finish materials are installed.

Step 4: Finish Work and Fixture Installation

After waterproofing inspection passes, the shower base or curbless pan is installed, followed by wall tile or shower panel, shower door or glass partition, and all fixtures including the showerhead, control valve, and any seating.

Step 5: Final Inspection

A city building inspector reviews the waterproofing and plumbing work. Upon passing, the bathroom is ready for use. A standard conversion timeline from start to final inspection is typically 3 to 5 weeks.

Real Tub to Shower Projects in Metro Vancouver

聚星装修 has completed tub-to-shower conversions in homes across Metro Vancouver. Below are actual completed projects with real costs.

Coquitlam — Standard Shower Conversion: A standard bathroom refresh in Coquitlam with shower conversion, full tile work, and curbless shower pan. The 4-week project addressed a senior homeowner seeking to age in place by removing the tub barrier.

North Vancouver — Luxury Curbless Shower: A high-end bathroom renovation in North Vancouver featuring a curbless walk-in shower, large-format tile, minimal glass partition, built-in seating, and rain shower head. This conversion was part of a whole-home bathroom renovation.

Richmond — Full Demolition with Drain Relocation: A Richmond bathroom where the original cast-iron drain required relocation due to floor joist constraints. The project took 5 weeks and included new waterproofing, curbless pan, and custom glass. Total cost reflected the complexity of the drain work.

Delta — Basic Insert Conversion: A straightforward tub-out, shower-insert conversion in Delta completed in 3 weeks for a young family that wanted to reduce ongoing maintenance. Cost was at the lower end of the range.

Does a Tub to Shower Conversion Need a Permit in Vancouver?

Not always. A straight swap of a tub for a shower insert — using the existing drain and not moving any plumbing — typically does not require a permit in Metro Vancouver municipalities. However, if the drain line is moved, the wet area is expanded, or the floor structure is altered, a plumbing permit is required. 聚星装修 advises clients on permit requirements during the initial assessment and handles the application when one is needed.

How Long Does a Tub to Shower Conversion Take?

A basic insert conversion typically takes 2 to 3 weeks from demolition to final inspection. A full conversion with drain relocation, custom tile, and glass can take 4 to 5 weeks. 聚星装修 provides a detailed timeline during the quote stage and manages all municipal inspection scheduling.

Is a Tub to Shower Conversion Worth It?

For homeowners planning to sell, a tub-to-shower conversion is one of the highest-ROI bathroom updates in Metro Vancouver. Buyers in family neighbourhoods — particularly in North Vancouver, Coquitlam, and Richmond — increasingly prefer showers over tubs. Removing a dated jetted tub and installing a curbless shower is a featured selling point that agents routinely highlight.

For homeowners staying in the home, the conversion improves bathroom accessibility and reduces maintenance (no jetted pump to repair, no door seals to replace). For aging-in-place renovations, it is often the single most impactful change.

溫哥華浴缸改淋浴的費用是多少？

大溫地區標準浴缸改淋浴的起始費用約為$8,500，採用基本改造和標準五金配件大多數改造項目的費用在$10,000至$14,000之間，包括管道修改和優質飾面。帶玻璃隔斷和高端瓷磚的無障礙淋浴改造費用可達$16,000至$18,000。

改造類型預估費用範圍（加元）

溫哥華浴缸改淋浴的流程

溫哥華每項浴缸改淋浴工程均遵循規範化流程，符合大溫地區的建築規範和許可要求。聚星裝修從初步評估到最終驗收全程管理整個流程。

第一步：初步評估和測量

聚星裝修估算師到現場評估現有浴缸、測量管道預埋件，並評估排水口位置是否適合淋浴配置。在1990年前建造的溫哥華老房子中，原始鑄鐵排水管可能需要移位，這會影響費用。

第二步：申請許可證（如需要）

在溫哥華、高貴林、北溫、列治文和三角洲，如改造涉及移動排水管線或改變濕區範圍，則需要管道許可證。聚星裝修作為項目管理費用的一部分辦理許可證申請。大溫地區許可費用通常在$150至$350之間。

第三步：拆除和隱蔽工程

拆除現有浴缸和圍板。如需重新配置排水管或供水管線，此工作在隱蔽工程階段完成。防水材料隨後應用於基層地板和牆壁，然後再安裝任何飾面材料。

第四步：飾面工程和五金安裝

防水驗收通過後，安裝淋浴底盤或無障礙底座，然後鋪設牆磚或淋浴間牆板、淋浴門或玻璃隔斷，以及所有五金配件，包括花灑頭、控制閥和任何座位。

第五步：最終驗收

市建築檢查員審查防水和管道工程。驗收通過後，浴室即可使用。標準改造從開工到最終驗收的整個時間線通常為3至5週。

大溫地區真實浴缸改淋浴工程案例

聚星裝修已在大溫地區各城市的住宅中完成浴缸改淋浴工程。以下均為實際完工項目，附真實費用。

高貴林——標準淋浴改造：高貴林一處標準浴室翻新項目，包含淋浴改造、全瓷磚工程和無障礙淋浴底盤項目，工期為4週。業主正在考慮居家養老，希望消除浴缸障礙。

北溫——豪華無障礙淋浴：北溫一處豪華浴室翻新項目，包含無障礙步入式淋浴，大規格瓷磚、極簡玻璃隔斷、座位和雨淋花灑。此改造是獨立屋整體浴室改造的一部分。

列治文——全拆除並排水管移位：

列治文一處浴室，因地板托梁限制，原始鑄鐵排水管需要移位。項目為期5週，包括新防水、 無障礙底盤和定制玻璃。費用反映了管道工程的複雜性。

三角洲——基本插入式改造：三角洲一處直接浴缸退出、淋浴插入改造，年輕家庭希望減少持續維護工作。費用在範圍的低位。

浴缸改淋浴在溫哥華需要許可證嗎？

並非總是如此。在大溫地區，直接將浴缸更換為淋浴插入——使用現有排水管且不移動任何管道——通常不需要許可證。然而，如排水管線被移動、濕區擴大或地板結構被改變，則需要管道許可證。聚星裝修在初步評估階段為客戶提供許可證要求建議，並在需要時辦理申請。

浴缸改淋浴需要多長時間？

基本插入式改造通常從拆除到最終驗收需要2至3週。帶排水管移位、定製瓷磚和玻璃的完整改造可能需要4至5週。聚星裝修在報價階段提供詳細時間表，並管理所有市政驗收預約。

浴缸改淋浴值得嗎？

對於計劃售房的業主，浴缸改淋浴是溫哥華回報最高的浴室更新之一。在北溫、高貴林和列治文等家庭社區，買家越來越傾向淋浴而非浴缸。拆除過時的按摩浴缸並安裝無障礙淋浴是代理經常強調的突出賣點。

對於留在家中養老的業主，改造提高了浴室無障礙性並減少維護工作（無需維修按摩泵，無需更換門密封條）。對於居家養老改造，這通常是最具影響力的單一改變。
